result:
The role select is in place in each users-table row, backed by a new `PATCH /users/{userId}/role` call. I did not run tests, lint, or the app, as you asked, so this is verified only by reading the code.

**What changed (all under `apps/react-vite/src`):**

- **`features/users/api/update-user-role.ts`** (new): a zod schema limited to `ADMIN` or `USER`, the `updateUserRole` fetcher, and `useUpdateUserRole`. The hook invalidates the users query on success, so the list refetches and shows the new role. It also shows a "User Role Updated" success notification, inside `onSuccess` as your CLAUDE.md requires.
- **`features/users/components/update-user-role.tsx`** (new): a native select bound to the row's current role. It is disabled while the request is pending, and it does not call `useNotifications` itself.
- **`features/users/components/users-list.tsx`**: the Role column now renders `UpdateUserRole` instead of plain text.
- **`testing/mocks/handlers/users.ts`**: an MSW handler for the new PATCH endpoint. It requires auth and admin, validates the role, scopes the update to the admin's team, and returns 404 for an unknown user. Without it the mock backend would not serve the new call.

**Choices I made that you may want to change:**

- The select also appears on the admin's own row. Demoting yourself to `USER` would make the page forbidden on the next refetch. The existing delete button hides itself on your own row, so you may want the same here.
- The role labels are the raw values (`ADMIN`, `USER`), not friendlier text.
- `delete-user.tsx` still calls `useNotifications` in the component, which breaks the repo rule. I left it alone since it is outside this change.

No `notes/` folder exists at the project root, so I did not create one.
